en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural village set in a forested valley. A dirt road curves through the foreground with two children standing at the roadside. On the left and center are several timber‑framed houses and farm buildings behind wooden picket fences, with laundry hanging in a yard. Densely wooded hills rise in the background. The image has the composition and border style typical of an early 20th‑century picture postcard. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the image side.
